tools.name: signrequest_list_documents
tools.description: List documents of the team with status, signers state and signing log links. API: GET /documents/.

tools.name: signrequest_get_document
tools.description: Get one document by uuid: status, signrequest with all signers, signing log, attachments, and temporary download links (pdf). API: GET /documents/{uuid}/.

tools.name: signrequest_search_documents
tools.description: Search documents by free text, name, signer email or status. API: GET /documents-search/.

tools.name: signrequest_list_signrequests
tools.description: List signature requests (the sent requests with their signers). API: GET /signrequests/.

tools.name: signrequest_get_signrequest
tools.description: Get one signature request by uuid, with each signer's viewed, signed, declined and forwarded state. API: GET /signrequests/{uuid}/.

tools.name: signrequest_list_templates
tools.description: List document templates (use a template uuid with signrequest_send_document). API: GET /templates/.

tools.name: signrequest_get_template
tools.description: Get one template by uuid, with its signer placeholders. API: GET /templates/{uuid}/.

tools.name: signrequest_list_teams
tools.description: List the teams the token can see (name, subdomain, sandbox flag). API: GET /teams/.

tools.name: signrequest_get_team
tools.description: Get one team by subdomain. API: GET /teams/{subdomain}/.

tools.name: signrequest_list_team_members
tools.description: List team members with admin, owner and active flags. API: GET /team-members/.

tools.name: signrequest_list_events
tools.description: List document events (sent, viewed, signed, declined, cancelled, bounced) and their callback delivery state. API: GET /events/.

tools.name: signrequest_send_document
tools.description: WRITE: creates a document and e-mails a signature request to the signers right away (not undoable except with signrequest_cancel_signrequest). Give exactly one source: a template uuid, a public file_from_url, or base64 file_from_content with file_from_content_name. API: POST /signrequest-quick-creat

tools.name: signrequest_cancel_signrequest
tools.description: WRITE: cancels a signature request that is not fully signed or declined. Signers who have not signed can no longer open the document. Not undoable. API: POST /signrequests/{uuid}/cancel_signrequest/.

tools.name: signrequest_resend_signrequest_email
tools.description: WRITE: sends the signature request e-mail again as a reminder to every signer who did not sign yet but already got the e-mail. API: POST /signrequests/{uuid}/resend_signrequest_email/.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: signrequest_search_documents, signrequest_cancel_signrequest · Private data: signrequest_list_documents, signrequest_get_document, signrequest_search_documents, signrequest_list_templates, signrequest_list_teams, signrequest_list_events, signrequest_send_document, signrequest_cancel_signrequest · Public sink: signrequest_search_documents, signrequest_send_document, signrequest_cancel_signrequest, signrequest_resend_signrequest_email.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: signrequest_search_documents, signrequest_cancel_signrequest · Private data: signrequest_list_documents, signrequest_get_document, signrequest_search_documents, signrequest_list_templates, signrequest_list_teams, signrequest_list_events, signrequest_send_document, signrequest_cancel_signrequest · Public sink: signrequest_search_documents, signrequest_send_document, signrequest_cancel_signrequest, signrequest_resend_signrequest_email

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
